svg.title: The shrimp's moods
svg.desc: While the countdown runs the shrimp stands calm. When a posture check is due it cranes its head forward with a doubtful look, slumps after 20 seconds, hunches over and starts turning red after a minute, curls up into a fuming ball by two and a half, sets its seaweed on fire around four minutes, and is furious by eight and a half. Clicking it makes it sparkle and restarts the countdown.
